title: Practices
noActivePlayer: First <link>set an active player</link>, then you'll be able to schedule a practice.

detail.heading: Practice
detail.calendarWarning: This practice overlaps with another event in your Google Calendar.

linked.heading: {discipline} practice
linked.readOnlyNote: Recorded by the player's {discipline} coach. You can see it, but only they can change it.

copy.heading: Also record for another player
copy.hint: Was someone else on court? They get the same practice with the same drills, and you can adjust it for them afterwards.
copy.hintOrg: Was someone else on court? They get the same practice with the same drills. For another coach's player it lands in their coach's app, so only that coach can edit it.
copy.copiedToOtherCoach: Recorded for {name} — it is now in {coach}'s app.

reschedule.heading: Reschedule practice
reschedule.hint: Drills stay as they are, only the time changes.
reschedule.confirmMessage: Move the practice to {date}, duration {duration} min?

review.heading: Review
review.confirmCompleteMessage: Are you sure you want to complete this practice? Once completed, it can no longer be edited.
review.confirmDeleteMessage: Are you sure you want to cancel this practice? The practice and its drills will be permanently deleted, this action cannot be undone. If it is in your Google Calendar, the event is removed too.
review.confirmCancelMessage: Are you sure you want to cancel this practice? It stays in the organisation's records as cancelled, and its drills are kept. If it is in your Google Calendar, the event is removed.

errors.missingDate: Select the practice date and time.
errors.reviewLocked: The practice is locked, notes could not be saved.
errors.rescheduleLocked: Only a planned practice can be rescheduled.
errors.copyInvalidPlayer: Pick one of your other active players.
errors.copyDuplicate: {name} already has a practice at that time.
errors.copyDuplicateOrg: That player already has a practice at that time.
errors.replaceFailed: Failed to add the replacement drill.
